intro: common/autonomous_states/ · custom puppet / subject autonomy states (clone of dynamic modifiers)
emptyScoped: No autonomy states under {country} · click 「+ New」
selectHint: Select an autonomy state on the left to edit · or click 「+ New」
isPuppetHint: Subject is a puppet (is_puppet / is_puppet_of triggers become true)
isDefaultHint: Emits `default = yes` — the fallback autonomy level a new subject starts at
manpowerInfluenceHint: 0–1 · share of the subject's manpower the overlord draws. Leave blank to omit (HOI4 default).
minFreedomLevelHint: Integer 0–1000 (= the 0–1 freedom scale ×1000, so 400 = 0.4 = integrated puppet). Avoid two states sharing the same value.
ruleHint: Sets the subject's game rules (can_not_declare_war, can_decline_call_to_war, …). One per line.
aiWeightsLabel: AI weight blocks · key = raw block body (ai_subject_wants_higher / ai_overlord_wants_lower / …)
noAiWeights: No AI weights · click 「+ Add field」 to add an ai_* block
modifierLabel: Modifier scalar fields · vanilla key = value (autonomy_manpower_share / cic_to_overlord_factor / …)
noFields: No fields · click 「+ Add field」 to add a vanilla modifier field
usageExample: Usage example (set in a country history file)
usageComment: Set the subject's autonomy state via the set_autonomy effect
